bsd_rate_max.note: IRAS residential BSD bands on/after 15 Feb 2023: 1/2/3/4/5/6% at $180k/$360k/$1m/$1.5m/$3m. Tools previously encoded the pre-2023 1/2/3/4% bands (top $1m @3%, remaining @4%).

ehg_max.note: CPF: EHG up to $120,000 for couples/families (two first-timer applicants); up to $60,000 for singles. Tool tier table previously stopped at $80,000 for the lowest income band.

shg_max.note: Special CPF Housing Grant (SHG) discontinued; replaced by the CPF Housing Grant (CHG) — up to $80,000 for 2-4 room / $50,000 for 5-room+ resale flats, income ceiling now $16,000.
